exposure: Presenting difficulties/symptoms (abdominal pain, fits, headaches, hematuria, visual changes, reduced urination, shortness of breath, weakness, vomiting, leaking or bleeding per vaginum, irritability, head reeling, jaundice, pedal oedema)
cohort: The study included 62 pregnant women diagnosed with HELLP syndrome, admitted to a tertiary healthcare facility in India.
finding: The majority of HELLP syndrome patients (61.3%) were aged between 21 and 30, with abdominal pain being the primary complaint across various gestational ages.
gest_age: 27.4% at 28-32 weeks, 12.9% at 33-34 weeks, 19.3% at 35-36 weeks, 25.8% at 37-38 weeks, 12.9% at 39-40 weeks, and 1.6% post-term (at diagnosis)
